evidence.title: OpenAI hires new energy regulatory lead
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Friedman moves from Amazon Web Services, where he spent more than four years, most recently as its senior corporate counsel. [e001:f02] Friedman has also held positions at law firms Davis Wright Tremaine LLP and McDermott Will & Schulte. [e001:f03] In this role, Friedman will manage energy regulatory strategy, policy execution, and infrastructure growth. [e001:f04] This will include the evaluation of jurisdictional pathways, support in utility and energy transactions, and the coordination of regulatory approvals and filings. [e001:f05] According to the job posting earlier this year, the role is an individual contributor lead role and does not have direct reports initially. [e001:f06] OpenAI has been building out its energy team in recent years as it moves to take a more central role in energy procurement. [e001:f07] Last month, the company advertised for a clean energy and new technology lead. [e001:f08] The role's salary range is advertised as $223,000 to $385,000 per year and will be fully remote. [e001:f09] The listing is now closed for applications. [e001:f10] More in North America The Xcelerated Compute Show | New York 2026 - Post Event Report 24 Sep 2026 Woodway to build 22-mile gas pipeline for undisclosed data center in US 28 Aug 2026 Volato Group signs merger agreement with AI infrastructure company Alignment Engine, Inc. [e001:f11] Tags OpenAI Will Friedman Comments。

evidence.title: OpenAI、全サービスで安全基準を統一。「SafetyIDs」で悪用対策を強化
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 「SafetyIDs」で悪用対策を強化 編集部：吹越友一 2026年10月23日 10:51 OpenAIは10月21日、同社のAIモデルを提供するすべてのサービス間で安全性ポリシーや利用基準を統一する方針を発表した。 [e002:f02] 「GPT-6 Astra」などのモデルは、開発者や企業が構築できるものの可能性を広げる一方で、悪用のリスクも高まっている。 [e002:f03] これに伴い同社は、安全対策が有効に機能し、一貫して適用されるよう取り組んでいるという。 [e002:f04] 11月20日に発効する改定後の利用ポリシーでは、モデルルーターやAIゲートウェイなど、モデルへの直接アクセスを提供するサービスに対して事前に審査と承認を受けることが義務化される。 [e002:f05] さらに、エンドユーザーの身元を知ることなく、個々のユーザーを区別できるようになる「SafetyIDs」なども順次導入される。 [e002:f06] 同社は、モデルの能力が高まるにつれ、悪用の検出、調査、対応の方法も改善し続けるとしたうえで、明確なルールと一貫した安全対策を整備することで、開発者や企業が安心してAI技術を活用できる環境を整えていくとしている。 [e002:f07] URL 🔗ニュースリリース https:// 🔗OpenAI https://。

evidence.title: Google Cloud expands model choice and flexibility, bringing OpenAI models to customers
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Key to the foundation of openness and choice is giving customers flexibility to run agentic workloads across their choice of models and infrastructure to achieve the right balance of cost, capability, and performance. [e003:f02] Today, we are expanding that foundation by launching OpenAI models in Google Cloud’s model garden. [e003:f03] Google Cloud is now the only hyperscale cloud provider offering access to all three leading closed source LLMs, alongside more than 200 first-party, third-party, and open models on a unified enterprise AI platform. [e003:f04] By adding OpenAI’s newest models to model garden, we are giving teams options across the full spectrum of enterprise workloads. [e003:f05] For OpenAI models: GPT-6 Astra : Designed for demanding work across coding, computer use, professional tasks, and scientific research. [e003:f06] Using the platform, customers can dynamically select and swap the optimal model for any use case based on performance, latency, and cost efficiency without architectural lock-in or separate vendor contracts. [e003:f07] Because OpenAI models are transacted directly through Google Cloud Marketplace, all usage appears on a single Google Cloud invoice, draws down existing cloud commitments, and counts toward Flexible Savings Plans (FSP) across model providers. [e003:f08] We ensure that running any third-party or OpenAI workload meets the most rigorous enterprise standards: Strict data perimeters : Customer prompts, context, and outputs remain entirely within your designated data perimeter and are never used to train foundation models, with Zero Data Retention (ZDR) options available coming soon. [e003:f09] Isolated access boundaries : OpenAI models run on dedicated Google Cloud infrastructure with Confidential Compute coming soon. [e003:f10] All queries are routed through hardened, isolated gateways, ensuring data transit remains strictly within Google Cloud's secure environment and third-party model providers have no unauthorized access to your cloud environment. [e003:f11] Unified auditing and identity : Every agent and model interaction operates under an authenticated identity, giving IT administrators end-to-end visibility, VPC Service Controls protection, and unified audit logging across their entire enterprise footprint. [e003:f12] “Helping customers put AI to work across their enterprise content requires leading models backed by strong security and rigorous compliance standards,” said Yashodha Bhavnani, VP of AI Products at Box. [e003:f13] “By using OpenAI models through Google Cloud, we will be able to give customers access to OpenAI’s frontier AI models alongside Google Cloud’s security and compliance capabilities, enabling them to get more value from their enterprise content. [e003:f14] This is a step toward operating more efficiently as we bring AI to customers.” Getting started OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna models are rolling out now in private preview to select enterprise customers in Google Cloud’s model garden, with more coming soon. [e003:f15] Starting today, customers can build with these models through our APIs and connect their local Codex CLI and Desktop workflows directly to our Gemini platform for inference. [e003:f16] Coming soon, OpenAI models will be available in Google Cloud’s Gemini for business and Google Antigravity, providing enterprise customers and developers with model choice flexibility and the best model for each task.

evidence.title: OpenAI Hires Former AWS Partner Sales Leader To Drive AI Channel Growth
evidence.body: [e004:f01] OpenAI has hired former AWS partner sales leader Ignacio Guillen as its new partner director in charge of go-to-market for the AI superstar. [e004:f02] “At AWS, I helped businesses adopt cloud technology,” Guillen said in a LinkedIn post announcing his hiring. [e004:f03] I’m excited to bring that experience to OpenAI and continue working with customers and partners,” said Guillen, OpenAI’s new go-to-market partner director. [e004:f04] Guillen spent over eight years at AWS from 2018 until April 2026. [e004:f05] His most recent role was senior leader of partner sales for AWS’ commercial accounts. [Related: AWS Reject AI Model Monopoly, Backs OpenAI And Anthropic Models; Channel Chief Says No ‘One Model To Rule Them All’ ] Guillen also held AWS partner sales leadership and management roles around enterprise accounts, as well as SMB and startup accounts over his tenure. [e004:f06] OpenAI Hiring Cloud Channel Exec Talent; Launches OpenAI Partner Network Guillen adds to OpenAI’s growing partner executive leadership team hailing from cloud providers like AWS and Google Cloud. [e004:f07] This year, Google Cloud’s global partner programs leader, Colleen Kapase, left to join OpenAI. [e004:f08] In addition, Google Cloud’s partner network managing director, Philip Larson, recently departed to join OpenAI. [e004:f09] Last month, OpenAI hired former Google and AWS executive Brian Kane as its new director of cloud partnerships. [e004:f10] This summer, OpenAI officially launched its flagship inaugural partner program: the OpenAI Partner Network. [e004:f11] OpenAI is initially investing $150 million in the channel with the launch of the OpenAI Partner Network to support and help partners bring the benefits of AI to more organizations more quickly. [e004:f12] AWS Partner CEO: Hirings Boost Partnership Justin Copie, CEO of AWS partner Innovative Solutions, said OpenAI is making waves in the channel this year with the hiring of top talent and seeking partners to get skilled on OpenAI technology tied to cloud providers. [e004:f13] Copie believes it’s beneficial to have OpenAI partner executives who have top-notch experience working at cloud leaders like AWS and Google Cloud so they can hit the channel ecosystem ground running. [e004:f14] “We’re going to be building this OpenAI partnership with confidence,” Copie added. [e004:f15] Innovative believes these hires will help accelerate OpenAI and AWS’ integration strategy and form a stronger partnership versus the competition. [e004:f16] We’re going to actually be releasing some things over the next few weeks with OpenAI specifically to start migrating those OpenAI workloads onto AWS versus Azure.” Guillen’s Channel Career At Google, Eliza And Cisco Meraki Over the past nearly two decades, Guillen has worked at companies including Google, Cisco Meraki and global manufacturer Venair Group in various sales and management roles.

evidence.title: Fernando Alonso calls for Honda investigation amid ongoing complaints
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Fernando Alonso has continued to voice concerns over the Honda power unit powering the Aston Martin Formula 1 car. [e003:f02] Singapore posed another tough weekend for the Silverstone-based team, which has spent the new regulations at the back of the field. [e003:f03] Although the team have worked hard to improve the car for both Lance Stroll and Alonso, the results have been slow ot come. [e003:f04] The Spaniard has been closest to results, narrowly missing Q2 in Singapore. [e003:f05] However, in race situations, the Aston Martin drivers have increasingly found themselves off the pace and frustrated. [e003:f06] After the race, Alonso said: “There is something on the power unit, yes, that is not performing as it should this weekend.” “We need to understand why, because obviously there are a couple of tough races coming. [e003:f07] Mexico will be the next one with very slow-speed corners. [e003:f08] There are a couple of things that are costing us a lot of lap time, and we discovered them the hard way this weekend.” The Spaniard was asked whether the issues were specific to Marina Bay and its unique characteristics or part of a larger problem with the Honda power unit. [e003:f09] “In Sepang we had no issues, and even in Baku, Baku was very twisty and very slow, the first two sectors, and we didn’t have any issues. [e003:f10] So it seems very specific to this track, and I don’t have any answers.” Fernando Alonso has voices his concerns with the Honda PU Continued problems It wasn't just the driveability issues that plagued Aston Martin across the weekend, with Alonso struggling with his turbo. [e003:f11] “I don’t think the car knew exactly where I was in the lap because I was deploying in different places that I didn’t need, and I was not deploying on the straight, so it was a little bit frustrating. [e003:f12] “But yesterday the turbo was broken, so I had to change it.” Alonso further clarified the issues. explaining they weren't isolated to the Virtual Safety Cars. [e003:f13] “But here on the virtual, in the first one, I could have overtaken [Sergio] Perez, and I ended up not overtaking, but also losing the position with [Isack] Hadjar. [e003:f14] “Then in the last virtual as well, I lost like two seconds on the restart. [e003:f15] Especially on the soft tyre, I think the first stint was very strong. [e003:f16] But we ended up behind Checo, well, behind any car, and then we lost 200, 300 metres every straight.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e004:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e004:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e004:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e004:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e004:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e004:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e004:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e004:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e004:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e004:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: なぜトヨタ新型RAV4は、本場アメリカでホンダCR-Vに8万台差で負けたのか。品薄だけじゃない「快適性」の差
evidence.body: [e005:f01] アメリカでは販売から4年目のホンダCR-V。 [e005:f02] ホンダ公式メディアサイト Advertisement SUVの主戦場アメリカにおいて、2026年に全面刷新したばかりのトヨタRAV4が、現地で発売から4年目※のホンダCR-Vに販売面で大きく引き離されている。 [e005:f03] 旧型と新型を合わせた車名別の集計で、2026年1〜9月は CR-Vが33万6844台 、 RAV4が25万3664台 。 [e005:f04] 前年同時期はRAV4が5万633台多かったため、 1年で立場が入れ替わったことになる。 [e005:f05] 結論を先に言えば、差が開いたきっかけは、新型への切り替えで起きたRAV4の品薄だった。 [e005:f06] だが、RAV4の供給が戻り始めた9月でも、CR-VはRAV4の猛追を振り切って首位を守り、9月としての過去最高を記録した。 [e005:f07] ※北米で先行販売した現行CR-Vは日本でも2026年にハイブリッド版が投入されている 品薄の間にCR-Vは客を取り込んだ トヨタ公式メディアサイト Advertisement そもそも、なぜRAV4の品薄が起きたのか。 [e005:f08] トヨタは旧型から新型RAV4への生産の切り替えに向け、日本やカナダの工場で生産ラインの改修を順次進めた。 [e005:f09] しかし、品質を担保するために立ち上げを慎重に進めた結果、一時的に生産ペースが落ち込み、販売店の在庫がほとんどない状態に陥った。 [e005:f10] 1〜9月の販売を前年と比べると、RAV4は10万4470台減り、CR-Vは2万9343台増えた。 [e005:f11] 両車の差を動かした13万台余りのうち、8割近くはRAV4の減少によるものだ。 [e005:f12] RAV4は前年同月比6.6％減まで持ち直し、単月の差は596台まで縮んだ。 [e005:f13] その月にCR-Vは前年同月比21.9％増の3万4788台を売り、9月の過去最高を更新した。 [e005:f14] 前輪駆動（FF）のハイブリッド同士なら、メーカー希望小売価格はRAV4が3万1900ドル（約504万円）、CR-Vが3万5630ドル（約563万円）からで、 RAV4のほうが3730ドル（約59万円）安い。 [e005:f15] 自動車情報サービスKelley Blue Bookが年1万2000人を超す新車購入検討者に聞いた 2026年の調査 で、ホンダは大衆ブランド部門の6賞を独占し、「 最も信頼されるブランド 」にも選ばれた。 [e005:f16] では、内装や静粛性といった快適性の評価において、RAV4はどうCR-Vの後塵を拝したのか。

evidence.title: Michael Mosiman Signs with Quad Lock Honda for the 2027 Season
evidence.body: [e006:f01] The American will join the Quad Lock Honda team, where he will compete in the 250cc class of the AMA Supercross, Pro Motocross and SuperMotocross championships. [e006:f02] The team announced Mosiman’s arrival on social media. [e006:f03] With the American, Quad Lock Honda adds an experienced rider who has already proven in the past that he can win races at the highest level. [e006:f04] For Mosiman, the move marks a new chapter in his career. [e006:f05] At Quad Lock Honda, he will have the opportunity to fight at the front again in the highly competitive 250cc class. [e006:f06] The team is confident about the upcoming partnership. [e006:f07] “A proven race winner with unfinished business. [e006:f08] We’re ready to get to work,” Quad Lock Honda stated. [e006:f09] In 2027, Mosiman will contest the AMA Supercross Championship, the Pro Motocross Championship and the SuperMotocross Playoffs aboard the Honda CRF250R. imunify-bot-check。

evidence.title: 【Ｆ１】アストンＭ〝最後通告〟ホンダに来季開幕戦で目標達成できなければ「提携解消」へ（東スポWEB）
evidence.body: [e007:f01] アストンマーティンは新規定で臨んでいる今季にマシン不備などで低迷し、大型アップデートした今でも、復調できずにいる。 [e007:f02] 同メディアは「アストンマーティンが性能の低いホンダ製エンジンについて非常に不満を抱いていることは周知の事実だ。 [e007:f03] 特にフェルナンド・アロンソ（スペイン）はシンガポール・グランプリ（GP）の際、ホンダを批判し、チーム無線でエンジンを嘲笑する発言をした」という。 [e007:f04] そこで両者の契約最終年となる来季に向け「アストンマーティンはホンダが2027年の開幕戦までに設定した目標を達成できなかった場合、他エンジンメーカーとの提携を検討する用意がある」と報道。 [e007:f05] またスペイン紙「アス」も「27年の最初のレースに向けてエンジンが大きな進化を遂げてトップ10位入りすることを期待している。 [e007:f06] しかし、実現しない場合、他のところに求める可能性がある」と伝えた。 [e007:f07] すでにアストンマーティンはメルセデスやレッドブルパワートレインなどと接触し、提携の可能性を探っていると報じられている。 [e007:f08] すでに今季は大型アップデートを行わない方針。 [e007:f09] 来シーズン開幕戦となるバーレーンGPでポイントが獲得できなければ、提携解消となる見込みだ。 [e007:f10] 東スポWEB 【関連リンク】 【F1】アストンマーティン不振〝真相〟はニューウェイ氏の奇抜デザインか 元ハース代表が指摘 【F1】アロンソ元側近がストロール氏は怒り心頭と指摘「日本人全員の襟首をつかんでやる」＝英メディア 平子理沙 F1ドライバーに誘われた過去を自ら暴露 【F1】アストンマーティンは〝迷走状態〟アロンソが指摘した「ホンダエンジンのさらなる問題」 【F1】アロンソとホンダが〝対立〟「直線でスピードが出なかった」「エンジンに問題はない」。

evidence.title: Aston Martin announces first-of-its-kind F1 partnership ahead of US GP
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Aston Martin has partnered with Padeltek to launch a range of branded padel rackets and accessories ahead of the United States Grand Prix Aston Martin has become the first Formula 1 team to partner with a padel and pickleball company, teaming up with Padeltek for a range of rackets that will go on sale this week. [e002:f02] The Silverstone outfit announced the new collaboration ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, where the team and Padeltek will host an exclusive I / AM fan event at a brand-new padel venue, Padel Society. [e002:f03] The Aston Martin Padeltek collection will include three padel rackets and three cover bags. [e002:f04] "Formula 1 is a platform for collaboration across wider sport and lifestyle spaces, and we're continuing to see the growing demand from fans to bring the worlds together," Aston Martin head of licensing and merchandise Matt Chapman explained. [e002:f05] "As the first Formula 1 team to formally partner with a padel and pickleball company, we're excited to combine our brand DNA via a tangible product that feels authentic and performance-driven." Ron Saslow, founding and managing partner of Thirty-5 Capital, added: "It didn't take long for padel and Formula 1 to find each other. [e002:f06] Both sports reward precision, speed and performance, and both are attracting a growing fan base here in the United States. [e002:f07] "For Padeltek, collaborating with the Aston Martin Aramco Formula 1 Team is an opportunity to bring that shared energy to the court, creating equipment that gives racing fans a new way to connect with their team while introducing more people to padel." The partnership will continue to expand in 2027, with pickleball rackets and accessories planned for release. [e002:f08] Padel has become increasingly popular among F1 drivers, with many now incorporating it into their training routines. [e002:f09] Aston Martin heads into the United States Grand Prix, which is scheduled for 23-25 October, 10th in the constructors' standings with seven points. [e002:f10] Two-time champion Fernando Alonso is 17th in the drivers' championship, having earned all seven of the team's points, and his team-mate Lance Stroll is 21st with no points.

evidence.title: FIAが2027年F1レギュレーションで情報共有を厳格規制 他部門との技術流用を防止
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 予算制限を回避するためにF1以外の部門で開発作業を行い、その成果をF1に持ち込む行為を防ぐことが目的だ。 [e003:f02] 10月19日に世界モータースポーツ評議会（WMSC）が承認した2027年F1運営レギュレーションには、「F1活動と非F1活動の物理的・IT上の分離」と題する第F6条が新設された。 [e003:f03] この条項では、F1部門と他事業の職場やITシステムを分離するだけでなく、技術情報の移転方法や従業員の異動条件まで細かく定めている。 [e003:f04] F1と非F1事業を物理的・IT上で分離 FIAが公開した2027年F1運営レギュレーションの第F6条は、F1活動と非F1活動の間に明確な境界を設けることを求めている。 [e003:f05] 対象となるのは、同じ企業グループのなかでF1とそれ以外の事業を展開し、人員や施設、ITシステムなどを共有する組織だ。 [e003:f06] 第F6.5条では、F1部門と非F1部門の間で人員を異動させる際の条件が定められている。 [e003:f07] F1部門への異動時には、新たな役職、責任、組織上の意味を明記した契約上の取り決めも必要となる。 [e003:f08] 異動後は、少なくとも連続12カ月間、F1活動などレギュレーションで認められた業務に専従しなければならない。 [e003:f09] ただし、異動に際して新たな契約上の取り決めを結び、従来のF1関連ITアクセス権限を取り消さなければならない。 [e003:f10] ただし、移転できるのは非F1活動に必要な情報に限られ、事前の申請、承認、記録が必要となる。 [e003:f11] 情報の移転に伴って両部門の従業員が説明や協議を行う場合にも、対象となる情報の説明や実演に内容を限定する必要がある。 [e003:f12] さらに、こうした協議はビデオ会議で行い、録画と文字起こしを残して、FIAから求められた場合に提出できるようにしなければならない。 [e003:f13] 違反時は人件費の算入額が2027年に3倍 2028年には6倍に 新しい分離要件は、F1の予算制限とも密接に関係している。 [e003:f14] 2027年には対象費用を3倍、2028年には6倍として扱う措置が報じられている。 [e003:f15] 例えば、対象となる人件費が100万ドルであれば、3倍の算入が適用される場合、予算制限上は300万ドルとして扱われることになる。 [e003:f16] FIAが今回の変更で重視しているのは、予算制限の対象となるF1開発活動が、他事業の名目で実施される抜け道を塞ぐことだ。

evidence.title: Qatar Grand Prix issues update after FIA President calendar claim
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Officials at the Lusail International Circuit have said preparations for the Qatar Grand Prix are nearing completion, with the circuit due to host both Formula 1 and MotoGP in November. [e004:f02] Uncertainty had surrounded the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix, with conflict in the Middle East having already impacted the Formula 1 calendar this season. [e004:f03] Qatar Grand Prix preparations ‘nearing completion’ with F1 calendar slot approaching The Bahrain and Saudi Arabian Grands Prix were initially cancelled as conflict broke out nearby, and Formula 1 has long held a contingency plan of a race in Europe if the two season closers are unable to be staged. [e004:f04] The Lusail International Circuit itself also postponed the Qatar 1812km in March, the season opener in the World Endurance Championship. [e004:f05] However, Formula One Management and the FIA have both recently hinted that the Formula 1 races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi will go ahead as planned. [e004:f06] FIA President, Mohammed Ben Sulayem, said earlier this week that the rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi “are going to happen”, adding “the FIA is always ready” if plans have to change quickly. [e004:f07] He told and other media: “We will never take our staff or drivers or any officials to a place where we feel it is risky. [e004:f08] I cannot predict this. [e004:f09] I can only tell you today that there is nothing, and the two races are going to happen.” FOM is understood to be looking to stage the calendar as previously scheduled, barring any sudden change of circumstance. [e004:f10] For its part, the Lusail International Circuit has been preparing to make sure “every aspect” of the circuit will be able to welcome fans to Grand Prix racing in November. [e004:f11] The circuit’s CEO, Abdulaziz Ali Al-Mohannadi, said: “We are looking forward to welcoming the world back to Lusail International Circuit in November for two of the most anticipated events on the international motorsport calendar, just three weeks apart. [e004:f12] “Our preparations are nearing completion, with our teams focused on ensuring that every aspect of the venue is ready to deliver an exceptional experience for fans, as we do every year. [e004:f13] Complete F1 2027 calendar officially released “The fan experience remains at the heart of our preparations for every event hosted by Lusail International Circuit. [e004:f14] “We are constantly working to provide a comprehensive experience for every visitor, whether they are motorsport enthusiasts or families looking to enjoy special moments together, reflecting our commitment to renowned hospitality and organisational excellence.” The Qatar Grand Prix is on the calendar for the weekend of 28-30 November, with the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix scheduled to round off the season from 5-7 December. [e004:f15] Join our broadcast channel on WhatsApp to get the scoop on the latest developments from our team of accredited journalists. [e004:f16] Read next: How Kimi Antonelli can win the 2026 F1 title at the United States GP。

evidence.title: ライカとF1がライセンスパートナーシップを締結。『ライカQ3 43』のF1仕様が販売開始
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 『ライカQ3 43』のF1仕様が販売開始 オートスポーツweb 2026年10月21日 15時51分 ドイツのカメラメーカーであるライカカメラ社とF1は10月21日、ライセンスパートナーシップの締結を発表した。 [e007:f02] また、同日より『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』が販売開始となった。 [e007:f03] 『ライカQ3 43』をベースモデルとしたF1エディションは、ステアリングホイールを模した滑り止め加工のマイクロベロア素材のカバーを採用。 [e007:f04] さらに、トッププレートとレンズキャップにはF1のロゴがあしらわれている。 [e007:f05] さらに、カメラ本体に用いられている繊維模様は、軽量かつ高い剛性を兼ね備え、モータースポーツの世界で広く活用されている本物のカーボンが使用されている。 [e007:f06] なお、カーボンはこれまでのライカのカメラには使用されてこなかった素材だ。 [e007:f07] そして、『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』専用として、モータースポーツにふさわしい画像表現を実現するためのLeica Look『Formula 1』が開発された。 [e007:f08] ライカは「コントラストを高め、彩度を強めることで、サーキットやパドックで感じられる雰囲気を、撮影した写真に忠実に再現する」としている。 [e007:f09] このルックは『Leica FOTOS』アプリで『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』専用に提供される。 [e007:f10] 『ライカQ3 43 F1エディション』はライカストア、ライカオンラインストア、ライカブティックおよびライカ正規特約店にて2026年10月21日より発売されている。 [e007:f11] なお、ライカオンラインストアでの販売価格は1,595,000円（税込／2026年10月21日時点）となっている。

evidence.title: フェラーリがF1アメリカGPで特別リバリーを採用。設計図をイメージした複雑なグラフィックを再現したデザイン
evidence.body: [e008:f01] タイトルパートナーであるHPと協力して制作したデザインで、チームによると、「アイデアがF1マシンへと姿を変えるまでの創造... スクーデリア・フェラーリは、2026年F1第18戦アメリカGPでSF-26に使用するスペシャルリバリーを発表した。 [e008:f02] タイトルパートナーであるHPと協力して制作したデザインで、チームによると、「アイデアがF1マシンへと姿を変えるまでの創造とエンジニアリングのプロセスを称えるもの」だということで、スケッチや技術図面、設計図をイメージしたグラフィックが取り入れられている。 [e008:f03] 「オースティン仕様のデザインでは、マシンがサーキットに到着するはるか前に行われる作業、すなわち開発プロセスそのものを主役に据えた」とフェラーリは説明している。 [e008:f04] アストンマーティンがF1アメリカGP限定リバリーを発表。 [e008:f05] コグニザントとの5年間のパートナーシップを記念 「通常はノートやCADモデル、技術文書の中にとどまっているデザイン要素がマシンの外観の一部となり、コンセプトから実戦投入へと至る道のりを垣間見せる」 「このプロジェクトの実現には、マラネロのフェラーリチームとHPの専門家たちによる緊密な連携が不可欠だった。 [e008:f06] 複雑な曲面を持つF1マシンのボディに、精緻なグラフィックを正確に再現しながら、レースウイークエンドに求められる厳しい要件も満たすため、複数回にわたるテストと改良が重ねられた」 「F1でも最大級の規模と熱狂を誇るイベントに合わせて披露される今回の特別カラーリングは、フェラーリが受け継ぐ革新の伝統と、テクノロジー分野をリードするアメリカの強みを米国の舞台で融合させるものだ」 フェラーリは、ルイス・ハミルトンとシャルル・ルクレールがアメリカGPで、スペシャルデザインのレーシングスーツを着用することも明らかにしている。 [e008:f07] [オートスポーツweb 2026年10月22日]。

evidence.title: Lance Stroll offers damning Honda verdict in Aston Martin update
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Lance Stroll did not attempt to sugarcoat his appraisal of Honda's latest power unit upgrade for Aston Martin, which was quietly delivered at the Spanish Grand Prix. [e001:f02] Article To news overview © XPB Images Lance Stroll has delivered a blunt assessment of Honda's second ADUO engine upgrade, introduced quietly at the Madring in Spain, while expressing cautious optimism over Aston Martin's chassis direction for 2027. [e001:f03] The Canadian, who has been confirmed at the Silverstone-based outfit for next season, said he expects the AMR27 to mark a clear step forward on the aerodynamic side. [e001:f04] But he admitted the power unit situation remains the biggest unknown heading into the new regulations cycle. [e001:f05] Honda's second Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities package was fitted to Stroll's car in Spain, following the first ADUO update introduced at Zandvoort in August, which focused on reshaping the combustion chamber and pre-chamber and reducing internal friction through a revised lubrication system. [e001:f06] That update arrived after Honda was found to be trailing the leading internal combustion benchmark by more than four per cent, qualifying the manufacturer for two additional in-season upgrades under the FIA's concession mechanism. [e001:f07] Aston Martin's own in-season progress has been more visible, with a sweeping 16-part upgrade at the Hungaroring in July bringing a reprofiled nose, revised floor and diffuser, and a reworked rear wing aimed at unlocking more underfloor performance and allowing higher rear ride heights. [e001:f08] That work, although a clear step forward, has yet to translate into consistent results, with the team languishing tenth in the constructors' standings on seven points. [e001:f09] Asked what he has been told about the 2027 car, Stroll struck an upbeat tone over the chassis. [e001:f10] "We have a plan, a good direction. [e001:f11] "We don't know how we're going to be in the beginning of '27, so we'll see..." [Article continues below] Driver Lance Stroll Canadian Aston Martin 18 News Results Statistics Stroll: 'A lot of work to be done' with Honda That uncertainty hardened into criticism when Stroll was pressed on whether the Madring update, Honda's second ADUO intervention of the season, had moved the needle. [e001:f12] We know that, so a lot of work to be done." Honda has already undergone an internal reshuffle in response to the shortfall, with Yoichiro Fukao placed in charge of the programme at the start of October. [e001:f13] The manufacturer has acknowledged its power unit development was delayed by roughly two years due to a late decision to re-enter Formula 1 as a works supplier, leaving it chasing rivals on the FIA's ADUO index. [e001:f14] Also interesting: Join RacingNews365's Ian Parkes, Sam Coop and Nick Golding as they look ahead to this weekend's United States Grand Prix! evidence.title: Esteban Ocon responds to Haas signing Rafael Camara for F1 2027
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Esteban Ocon is being replaced by Ferrari junior Rafael Camara for 2027 and has no real options for an F1 drive next year Esteban Ocon agrees that his Haas replacement Rafael Camara deserves his chance to be in Formula 1, but feels he does not deserve to be without a seat for 2027. [e002:f02] Camara's signing was confirmed last week as the Brazilian steps up from F2 - where he is currently the championship leader. [e002:f03] Although Oliver Bearman is yet to be officially announced by Haas as staying at the team, the American outfit is hoping to extend his deal. [e002:f04] With no real opportunities left on the 2027 grid barring any surprise exits, Ocon's options are slim and the 30-year-old is most likely looking at a reserve deal to keep his hand in - rather than making a switch to a different category. [e002:f05] Ocon was adamant that his performances were not the reason for his departure, but once more would not be drawn on the specific reasons why Haas chose not to extend his deal. [e002:f06] What I will say is that Rafa deserves a shot in F1. [e002:f07] "But I don't deserve to be out of F1 at the same time. [e002:f08] "As I said, I deserve to be here in Formula 1. [e002:f09] But they are not the performance reasons. [e002:f10] Just thinking from a sports perspective, I deserve to be in F1. [e002:f11] I believe that this is not my last year in F1." Ocon's focus, then, was on ensuring that he could continue to deliver in his final races for Haas and assist the team in its fight to retain seventh in the constructors' championship - it is currently seven points clear of Audi. [e002:f12] Although he'd received public support following the news that he was out of a drive for 2026, Ocon stated that he didn't need private support from his fellow drivers - and nor had he received anyway. [e002:f13] "Lance came to speak to me for example. [e002:f14] I'm not calling for any support from any drivers or whatever. [e002:f15] It's a difficult world for everybody in a way. [e002:f16] If you don't perform for three races, you are the worst.

Fernando Alonso calls for Honda investigation amid ongoing complaints
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Fernando Alonso has continued to voice concerns over the Honda power unit powering the Aston Martin Formula 1 car. [e003:f02] Singapore posed another tough weekend for the Silverstone-based team, which has spent the new regulations at the back of the field. [e003:f03] Although the team have worked hard to improve the car for both Lance Stroll and Alonso, the results have been slow ot come. [e003:f04] The Spaniard has been closest to results, narrowly missing Q2 in Singapore. [e003:f05] However, in race situations, the Aston Martin drivers have increasingly found themselves off the pace and frustrated. [e003:f06] After the race, Alonso said: “There is something on the power unit, yes, that is not performing as it should this weekend.” “We need to understand why, because obviously there are a couple of tough races coming. [e003:f07] Mexico will be the next one with very slow-speed corners. [e003:f08] There are a couple of things that are costing us a lot of lap time, and we discovered them the hard way this weekend.” The Spaniard was asked whether the issues were specific to Marina Bay and its unique characteristics or part of a larger problem with the Honda power unit. [e003:f09] “In Sepang we had no issues, and even in Baku, Baku was very twisty and very slow, the first two sectors, and we didn’t have any issues. [e003:f10] So it seems very specific to this track, and I don’t have any answers.” Fernando Alonso has voices his concerns with the Honda PU Continued problems It wasn't just the driveability issues that plagued Aston Martin across the weekend, with Alonso struggling with his turbo. [e003:f11] “I don’t think the car knew exactly where I was in the lap because I was deploying in different places that I didn’t need, and I was not deploying on the straight, so it was a little bit frustrating. [e003:f12] “But yesterday the turbo was broken, so I had to change it.” Alonso further clarified the issues. explaining they weren't isolated to the Virtual Safety Cars. [e003:f13] “But here on the virtual, in the first one, I could have overtaken [Sergio] Perez, and I ended up not overtaking, but also losing the position with [Isack] Hadjar. [e003:f14] “Then in the last virtual as well, I lost like two seconds on the restart. [e003:f15] Especially on the soft tyre, I think the first stint was very strong. [e003:f16] But we ended up behind Checo, well, behind any car, and then we lost 200, 300 metres every straight.

evidence.title: F1 Reveals Leica Formula 1 Edition Camera as FIA Launches New Remote Center
evidence.body: [e004:f01] In a new partnership between F1 and Leica Camera, it has launched a Q3 43 Formula 1 Edition camera for consumers. [e004:f02] The camera, which will be available to buy from October 21, 2026, ‘enables exceptionally authentic photography’. [e004:f03] The Formula 1 logo is inscribed on the top plate and also on the lens cap. [e004:f04] The visible structure is made from genuine carbon, which is traditionally not used in making Leica cameras. [e004:f05] The photos will have higher contrast and richer saturation to capture the moving atmosphere in the world of F1. [e004:f06] The camera can be purchased at various Leica Stores, the Leica Online Store and from specialist retailers. [e004:f07] New ROC Inaugurated at Biggin Hill Elsewhere, the FIA launched the new Remote Operations Centre (ROC) at Biggin Hill, U.K., with Stefano Domenicali and President Mohammed Ben Sulayem in attendance, alongside Nikolas Tombazis, Tim Malyon and Steve Porter. [e004:f08] It is a significant investment in technology and infrastructure. [e004:f09] The idea of remote operations came after the 2021 F1 season, and it has been operational since then. [e004:f10] However, the new upgraded facility will help strengthen race management. [e004:f11] The new facility has been in use since the 2026 Dutch GP weekend, assisting the FIA Race Control and Stewards, with up to 16 staff working. [e004:f12] “It demonstrates what we can achieve when Formula 1 and the FIA work closely together with a shared ambition to deliver the highest standards across our sport. [e004:f13] This world-leading facility will support the FIA’s trackside activities across Formula 1, Formula 2 and Formula 3, strengthening the operations that are essential to fair and consistent competition. [e004:f14] “The inauguration of our new Remote Operations Centre represents an important milestone in the continued evolution of the FIA Formula One World Championship and our commitment to delivering the highest standards of safety, fairness and integrity across our sport,” he said. [e004:f15] “As the Championship grows globally, it is vital that we continue to invest in the people, technology and infrastructure that underpin world-class race operations. evidence.title: アウディF1、フレディ・スレイターのFP1デビューを発表。メキシコとブラジルで出走
evidence.body: [e006:f01] メキシコとブラジルで出走 オートスポーツweb 2026年10月23日 06時31分 アウディ・レボリュートF1チームは現地時間10月22日、同チームの若手ドライバー育成プログラムの一員であるフレディ・スレイターが、10月30日〜11月1日に開催される第19戦メキシコシティGP、11月6〜8日に開催される第20戦サンパウロGPにおいて、フリー走行1回目（FP1）に出走することを発表した。 [e006:f02] スレイターはイギリス出身の現在18歳。 [e006:f03] アウディの若手ドライバー育成プログラム『アウディ・ドライバー・ディベロップメント・プログラム』と最初に契約を結んだドライバーだ。 [e006:f04] 2026年はトライデントからFIA F3に参戦し、ドライバーズランキング2位でシリーズを終えた。 [e006:f05] 2027年は強豪インビクタ・レーシングからFIA F2参戦が決定している。 [e006:f06] アウディが強力にサポートする18歳の若手は、FIA F2参戦前にF1の公式セッションデビューを果たすことになった。 [e006:f07] メキシコシティGPとサンパウロGPでF1公式セッションへ参加するスレイターは「グランプリ・ウィークエンドでF1マシンのハンドルを握れることは、僕にとって大きな瞬間であり、子供のころから夢見てきたことだ。 [e006:f08] 今年は多くのことを学んだけど、アウディ・レボリュートF1チームでのFP1への参加は、トラックでの経験を積み重ね続けるための最良の機会となるだろうね」と、コメント。 [e006:f09] 「アウディ・ドライバー・ディベロップメント・プログラムの一員として、すでに素晴らしいチャンスをいくつも得ており、チームの信頼とサポートに感謝するとともに、コースに出られることを本当に楽しみにしている。 [e006:f10] ベストを尽くし、チームのプログラムに貢献するとともに、両セッションからできるだけ多くのことを学び取ることに集中する」 そしてアウディF1のレーシングディレクター兼育成プログラムディレクターを務めるアラン・マクニッシュは「ここ数年、フレディはトラックの内外で目覚ましい進歩を遂げてきた。 [e006:f11] 今こそ、フレディが次のステップへ進むべきときだ」と、コメント。 [e006:f12] 「メキシコとブラジルでの出走は、彼にF1ウィークエンドの貴重な経験をもたらすとともに、来シーズンFIA F2へステップアップする前に、さらなる成長を続けるための新たな機会となるだろう。 [e006:f13] 我々は、彼がR26（アウディF1の2026年型車両）を駆る姿を見ることを楽しみにしており、これら2回の重要なFP1セッションを通じて彼をサポートしていく」 [オートスポーツweb 2026年10月23日]。

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e008:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e008:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e008:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e008:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e008:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e008:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e008:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e008:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e008:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e008:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e008:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。
